import subprocess, pathlib
repo=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda')
subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'fetch','origin','chatgpt/blender-collab'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
commit=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','FETCH_HEAD'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
def show(path):
    return subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',f'FETCH_HEAD:{path}'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
for path in ['scripts/estudo_fachada_superior_6_janelas.py','scripts/estudo_acesso_superior_marquis_e_terreo.py']:
    code=show(path)
    exec(compile(code,path,'exec'),{'__name__':'__main__','__file__':str(repo/path)})
render_path='scripts/render_estudo_fachada_superior.py'
render_code=show(render_path)
exec(compile(render_code,render_path,'exec'),{'__name__':'__main__','__file__':str(repo/render_path)})
print('QA_PACKAGE_COMMIT='+commit)
